text:
sam: FYI we got customer reports of intermittent stalls on our marketplace GPU instances when running a mixed CUDA/ROCm inference pipeline this morning. Symptoms: long tail p99, occasional stuck kernels.

rita: Can you repro in our lab images? Which combos?

sam: Repro on our onprem-sim image: CUDA 12.4 + driver 540.x + ROCm 6.1 via MPS bridge. Logs show 'kernel hang: wait for semaphore' and long memcpy waits. snippet: ```2026-03-25T11:04:12Z ERROR kernel: wait semaphore timeout, memcpy stalled 300ms, GPU 0 util 99%```

omar: Interesting — we haven't exercised mixed CUDA/ROCm bridge heavily. Could be a runtime handshake regression in driver 540. Have you tried pure CUDA and pure ROCm runs?

sam: Pure CUDA (12.4 + 530.x) looks stable. Pure ROCm 6.0 image also stable. The issue crops up when we run a pipeline that spawns a ROCm-backed embedding worker and a CUDA generator sharing NVLINK.

leo (CloudMarket): From marketplace side we should consider pinning affected marketplace AMIs and images to safe combo while partner triages. What SKU footprint are we talking about?

rita: Affected SKUs: c5-gpu-large (NVLINK), g6x, onprem-appliance. Workloads: gen-32k-batch-4, cross-device-embed-flow.

sylvia (HWPartner): Thanks for the signal. On our side we ran quick validation and saw increased sync latency when crossing the ROCm/CUDA Ipc path with driver 540. We opened HW ticket #HP-2042 and attached kernel traces. Hypothesis: a fence ordering change introduced in 540 causes extra serialization across peer transfers.

leo (CloudMarket): Proposed immediate steps: 1) pin marketplace images for cross-device-capable SKUs to driver 530.x + CUDA 12.3, 2) create a short advisory for tenants using mixed pipelines, 3) run expanded canary that exercises cross-device transfer patterns. Agree?

omar: Agree. Also request eng-runtime add a small synthetic that does repeated segmented memcopies cross-device with varying batch sizes. Run that in canary lane.

ci-bot: [job:redwood/marketplace-cross-device-canary] failed 4133330501  case: "cross-embed-gen-32k"  p99 +45% vs baseline. report: https://ci.internal/reports/4133330501

sam: Thanks CI — that matches. leo can we do a staged image pin? start in canary 2% traffic, validate p99 and error rate, then 25% then GA. Keep a rollback tag like `marketplace:2026-03-25-pin-530`

leo (CloudMarket): Yes. I'll open infra PR infra/marketplace-image#870 to set the pin and create a canary rollout plan. Targeting canary in 20m.

sylvia (HWPartner): We'll prioritize the kernel traces. If it's an ordering regress we may have a micro-patch; otherwise we'll provide guidance to use the pinned driver for up to 7 days while upstream fixes. Ticket updated: https://partners.hw/s/HP-2042

rita: Also let's coordinate comms with support: short advisory to affected customers, linking to troubleshooting steps and mitigations (restart worker, pin image). leo can you draft?

leo (CloudMarket): Drafted advisory: "We27re aware of elevated tail latency for mixed CUDA/ROCm pipelines on certain SKUs. We are rolling a pinned image to mitigate. No data corruption expected. If you run mixed pipelines please test against `marketplace:2026-03-25-pin-530`." Posting to docs in 5m: https://docs.internal/marketplace/advisories/530-pin-2026-03-25.md

deploy-bot: [deploy] marketplace-canary/cross-device started 4133332200  canary id: c-2026-03-25-530pin

ci-bot: [job:redwood/marketplace-cross-device-canary] passed 4133333000  p99 within 5% of baseline.

sam: Canary smoke looks ok. Let's hold 30m and then promote to 25% if no regressions. Also tagging eng-legal for any required partner comms review.

sylvia (HWPartner): Update on ticket HP-2042: we reproduced the ordering regression and narrowed to a fence sequence in kernel ipc.c. We can supply a micro-patch but it needs validation across our silicon matrix. ETA 48h for validated patch.

omar: Good. Plan: pin marketplace images for 72h, promote patch once partner provides validated micro-patch, test in staging, then coordinate public rolling update.

leo (CloudMarket): Noted. I'll schedule a joint status call with HWPartner and SI next 24h window and share the advisory to customers in affected accounts.

rita: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the coordination hub. If anyone sees new regressions, post logs here.

sam: Closing loop when patch lands or GA image repromoted. Appreciate the fast partner response. :pray:
